condition_rule: Inherit common_conditions and add claim conditions.

conditions: Same group or pair of users
claims.conclusion: Conversations have unique IDs; multiple parallel conversations are supported.
Last message/file no longer correlates to the previous; value is user-visible and configurable per user/group. No deletion rule here.

conditions: User's specific private conversation, or specific conversation in user's affiliated group
claims.conclusion: User can request delivery/read notifications per message, time window, or whole conversation.

conditions: Group to which user is affiliated
claims.conclusion: Can request or stop notifications for all messages/files in a specific conversation or all group conversations.
Service shall be able to provide data distributed before the user affiliated or joined.

limitations: 不定义 Hang Time 数值或线级编码；未把历史提供能力解释为无限期保留或离线终端即时同步。
